name: update_sixteen_table_entries
description: Loops sixteen times over a table in global data, calling two update routines on each pass and a third routine with the table value and index when a flag in the game state is nonzero.

name: step_audio_channel_pair_envelope
description: Picks setup constants from a mode number, then steps a loop that writes period and volume values to the audio channel 2 and 3 hardware registers, waiting on a timer word between changes.

name: call_routine_by_state_flag
description: Tests a game-state word and calls one routine on either branch, then returns the pair of result registers unchanged.

name: call_routine_by_flag_partial
description: Same two-branch flag test as its neighbour, but the recovered body is much shorter than the instruction count suggests, so the decompilation is probably incomplete.

name: forward_single_call_result
description: Calls a single routine and returns the pair of result registers it leaves behind, acting as a pass-through wrapper.

name: forward_single_call_pair
description: Calls a single routine and passes its result pair straight back to the caller, with no data of its own.

name: run_six_pass_history_update
description: Runs a countdown of six passes that shift four-byte history words in game state, calls a routine, invokes a jump-table handler four times per pass, and waits for the graphics vertical blank.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines back to back and returns, with no local state.

name: sweep_two_passes_with_wait
description: Clears a game-state word, then runs two 24-step loops that each call a routine with a step value and add that value into the state word, with a busy wait between them.

name: bracket_call_with_state_values
description: Stores fixed values into a game-state word before and after calling a routine, switching the word from one constant to another around the call.

name: bracket_call_with_state_values
description: Stores fixed values into a game-state word before and after calling a routine, switching the word from one constant to another around the call.

name: wait_for_vertical_blank_loop
description: Calls the graphics library's vertical-blank wait in a countdown loop, passing the counter to each call.

name: update_two_channel_volume_levels
description: When the enable word is clear, clamps two level words to a maximum, shifts them down, and when a scaled level changes, calls routines that rewrite the matching channel setting; it restores a saved table pointer at the end.

name: update_channel_level_delta
description: When enabled and a level word is non-negative, stores that word shifted right by eleven bits, then calls a routine with the difference from a reference word and calls a second routine, restoring the saved table pointer afterwards.

name: update_level_delta_with_previous
description: Like its neighbour, but it reads the previously stored level before writing the new shifted level, and passes the difference between the reference word and that previous level.

name: call_if_level_nonzero
description: When a level word is non-negative and its shifted value is nonzero, calls one routine; otherwise it returns without doing anything.

name: call_pair_with_table_pointers
description: Saves a table pointer in game state, points it at one table and calls a routine, then at a second table and calls again, and restores the original pointer.

name: init_channel_timing_constants
description: Stores five fixed timing and level constants into game-state words, then, when an enable word is clear, calls four setup routines.

name: call_pair_with_table_pointers
description: Saves a table pointer in game state, points it at one table and calls a routine, then at a second table and calls again, and restores the original pointer.

name: init_channel_timing_constants
description: Stores five fixed timing and level constants into game-state words, then, when an enable word is clear, calls four setup routines using a different set of constants.

name: call_pair_with_table_pointers
description: Saves a table pointer in game state, points it at one table and calls a routine, then at a second table and calls again, and restores the original pointer.

name: init_high_range_timing_constants
description: Stores a mode word of three and five timing constants in the upper range, then calls four setup routines when an enable word is clear.

name: call_pair_with_table_pointers
description: Saves a table pointer in game state, points it at one table and calls a routine, then at a second table and calls again, and restores the original pointer.

name: reset_timing_constants_set_a
description: Zeroes the mode word, stores four timing constants, and when the enable word is clear calls four setup routines.

name: call_pair_with_table_pointers
description: Saves a table pointer in game state, points it at one table and calls a routine, then at a second table and calls again, and restores the original pointer.

name: reset_timing_constants_set_b
description: Zeroes the mode word, stores four different timing constants, and when the enable word is clear calls four setup routines.

name: call_pair_with_table_pointers
description: Saves a table pointer in game state, points it at one table and calls a routine, then at a second table and calls again, and restores the original pointer.

name: reset_high_range_timing_constants
description: Zeroes the mode word, stores the upper-range timing constants, and when the enable word is clear calls four setup routines.

name: store_shifted_xor_word
description: Exclusive-ORs two game-state words, shifts the result left by two bits, and stores it in another game-state word.

name: and_combine_bitplane_rows
description: When the enable word is clear, computes source and destination offsets from game state and a table, then loops over rows ANDing the words of four bitplanes from one buffer into another.

name: read_pixel_from_four_planes
description: Reads the bit at a given column in a given row across four bitplanes and returns the four plane bits packed together as a small number.

name: clear_memory_block_backwards
description: Zeroes a block of memory that ends at a fixed screen-buffer offset, writing zero longwords backwards in an unrolled loop.

name: clear_table_selected_rows
description: Looks up a row start address in a table using an index from game state, then zeroes a run of longwords counting down from a row count stored in game state.

name: fill_row_block_by_mask
description: Reads a mask word from game state, calls routines according to its low bits, then fills a block of longwords with all ones or all zeros according to one bit, counting down rows.

name: clear_longword_rows_backwards
description: Zeroes a block of longwords going backwards in steps of ten, repeating for the row count in game state until the counter wraps past zero.

name: fill_longword_rows_backwards
description: Sets a block of longwords to all ones going backwards in steps of ten, repeating for the row count in game state until the counter wraps past zero.

name: compute_row_offsets_for_fill
description: Derives a byte offset and a row count from two game-state words and stores both back into game state for the fill routines to use.

name: copy_full_screen_longwords
description: Copies a full screen-sized block of longwords from one buffer to another, eight longwords per loop step.

name: call_blit_bitmap_library
description: Forwards to the graphics library's bit-block copy routine through the library base; the body only makes the call.

name: advance_pseudo_random_word
description: Multiplies a game-state word by a fixed constant, adds one, stores the result back, and returns the new value together with the high part of the product.

name: build_row_offset_table
description: Fills a table with byte offsets that step forward by one row width per entry, then stores a second value returned by a helper call.

name: merge_pattern_into_bitplanes
description: Walks a 64000-byte area one byte column at a time, clearing destination bytes under an eight-entry pattern mask and then ORing in source bytes selected by the same pattern, for each of four bitplanes.

name: dispatch_if_point_in_bounds
description: Checks that a horizontal position lies within the 320-pixel-wide screen and a vertical position lies between two game-state limits, and if so calls a handler chosen from a jump table by an index.

name: dispatch_jump_table_handler
description: Calls one handler selected from a jump table by a small index, with no range checks.

name: repeat_handler_between_bounds
description: Calls one routine, then calls a handler from a register pointer once for each step from a start value to an end value.

name: paint_word_colour_0
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 0 every plane is cleared. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_1
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 1 only the first plane is set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_2
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 2 only the second plane is set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_3
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 3 the first two planes are set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_4
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 4 only the third plane is set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_5
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 5 the first and third planes are set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_6
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 6 the second and third planes are set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_7
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 7 the first three planes are set and the fourth cleared. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_8
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 8 only the fourth plane is set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_9
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 9 the first and fourth planes are set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_10
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 10 the second and fourth planes are set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_11
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 11 the first, second and fourth planes are set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_12
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 12 the third and fourth planes are set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_13
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 13 the first, third and fourth planes are set. Called through a handler table.

name: paint_word_colour_14
description: Stores one 16-pixel word into four bitplanes, setting or clearing each plane according to the bits of the colour index; for colour 14 the second, third and fourth planes are set. Called through a handler table.

name: set_word_all_four_planes
description: ORs one 16-pixel value into the same word position in all four bitplanes, setting those bits in every plane.

name: fill_plane_span_with_masks
description: Masks the first word of a horizontal span in four bitplanes, fills the words in between with a pattern in each plane until the end pointer is reached, then masks the last word.

name: build_scanline_edge_table
description: Walks a list of points, and for each segment between consecutive points computes a fixed-point x step with a division and writes one x value per scanline into an edge table, tracking the overall minimum and maximum rows.

name: clip_edge_points_to_bound
description: Copies a point list keeping only points on the visible side of a boundary value from game state, calling a routine to insert intersection points where a segment crosses the boundary, then repeats the pass for the opposite side.

name: interpolate_edge_x_coordinate
description: Stores a starting value from game state, then computes the x position where a line segment crosses a given scanline by linear interpolation with a signed division, and writes it into an edge table entry.

name: interpolate_edge_x_minus_one
description: Stores a game-state value minus one as a starting value, then computes the crossing point of a line segment on a scanline by linear interpolation with a signed division.

name: interpolate_edge_by_table_offset
description: Computes an interpolated edge value on a scanline using a signed division, choosing the formula by which endpoint is lower, and stores it into an output list.

name: interpolate_edge_by_state_base
description: Stores a game-state base value, then computes an interpolated edge value on a scanline with a signed division, choosing the formula by endpoint order.

name: dispatch_span_handler_by_order
description: Converts two horizontal coordinates into bitplane byte positions through a lookup table, and if the start lies before the end, calls a handler chosen from a jump table by an index.

name: call_indexed_handler
description: Calls a handler selected from a jump table by an index register, treating the indirect jump as a call.

name: call_indexed_handler
description: Calls a handler selected from a jump table by an index register, treating the indirect jump as a call.

name: clear_span_across_planes
description: Masks the first word of a horizontal span in four bitplanes, zeroes the words in between in every plane, then masks the last word.

name: mask_word_all_four_planes
description: ANDs one 16-pixel mask into the same word position in all four bitplanes, clearing every bit outside the mask.

name: mask_three_planes_set_one
description: Clears bits outside a mask in three bitplanes and ORs a value into the remaining plane at the same word position.

name: mask_two_planes_set_two
description: Clears bits outside a mask in two bitplanes and sets bits in the other two bitplanes at the same word position.

name: fill_plane_region_with_pattern
description: Loops over a region of bitplanes using bit-mask tables and a row stride, combining pattern bytes into two of the planes under masks until a stop condition ends the loop.

name: advance_bouncing_frame_index
description: Advances a small index stored in game state and keeps it between limits by bouncing it back, then uses it to select and store entries in a display table; the other branch takes its value from a helper call.

name: set_bit_fields_when_enabled
description: When the enable word is clear, calls a routine, then sets one group of bits and clears another group in a series of table words at fixed offsets.

name: set_bit_fields_in_table
description: Sets one group of bits and clears another in a series of table words at fixed offsets from a base pointer, without any enable check.

name: clear_bit_fields_in_table
description: When a state word is zero and the enable word is clear, calls a routine, then clears a group of bits in a series of table words at fixed offsets.

name: clear_bit_fields_without_check
description: Clears one group of bits in a series of table words at fixed offsets from a base pointer, with no enable check.

name: run_pending_update_once
description: When the enable word is clear, runs a routine and clears a pending flag if it was set, then calls three update routines.

name: call_routine_if_enabled
description: Calls one routine only when the enable word is clear, and does nothing otherwise.

name: draw_rect_rows_with_bounds
description: Checks that a rectangle's horizontal limits lie within the 320-pixel screen and its vertical limits within 200 rows, then steps down the rows by one 40-byte row stride, calling routines for each row.

name: draw_font_glyph_planes
description: Looks up a character's glyph in a font table using its offset from the space character, then writes the glyph's pixel rows into the bitplanes at a given position with per-plane bit masks.

name: forward_single_routine_call
description: Calls a single routine and returns, with no other work.

name: forward_single_routine_call
description: Calls a single routine and returns, with no other work.

name: draw_font_glyph_rows
description: Looks up a character's glyph in the font table by its offset from the space character, then writes eight pixel rows of it into the bitplanes, selecting rows with bits from a mode word in game state.

name: stub_return_only
description: Empty routine that only returns; it serves as an entry in a handler table.

name: enable_flag_and_call
description: Sets a game-state flag word to one, then calls a routine.

name: clear_flag_and_call
description: Sets a game-state flag word to zero, then calls a routine.

name: call_two_handlers_in_order
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: clear_bitmap_then_routine
description: Calls a graphics library wrapper that clears a bitmap using the block-clear routine, then calls one more routine.

name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls four routines in sequence and returns.

name: branch_on_routine_result
description: Calls a routine and, depending on whether its return value is non-negative, calls one of two further routines.

name: set_palette_colours_rgb4
description: Reads a colour entry through the graphics library's palette call, sets palette colours through the library's RGB setter several times, and returns a fixed result pair.

name: stub_return_only
description: Empty routine that only returns; it serves as an entry in a handler table.

name: set_palette_colours_rgb4
description: Reads a colour entry through the graphics library's palette call, sets palette colours through the library's RGB setter several times, and returns a fixed result pair.

name: set_palette_colours_rgb4
description: Reads a colour entry through the graphics library's palette call, sets palette colours through the library's RGB setter several times, and returns a fixed result pair.

name: set_palette_colours_rgb4
description: Reads a colour entry through the graphics library's palette call, sets palette colours through the library's RGB setter several times, and returns a fixed result pair.

name: wait_bottom_of_viewport
description: Calls the graphics library's wait for the bottom of the viewport and returns.

name: copy_sixteen_words_from_pointer
description: Copies sixteen words from a buffer pointed to by a structure entry into the global work area.

name: copy_32_words_from_pointer
description: Copies thirty-two words from a buffer pointed to by a structure entry into the global work area.

name: copy_long_block_by_flag
description: When a flag word is set, copies a short block of longwords from the source into one destination buffer and calls a routine; otherwise it copies to a second destination.

name: load_palette_rgb4
description: Loads a palette through the graphics library's palette-loading call, then calls one further routine.

name: load_palette_then_routine
description: Loads a palette through the graphics library's palette-loading call, then calls one further routine.

name: copy_block_to_work_buffer
description: Copies a block of longwords and words from the source into a buffer selected from a pointer in game state, then calls a routine.

name: clear_work_buffer_by_flag
description: Zeroes either eight or sixteen longwords of a work buffer, chosen by a flag, then calls a routine.

name: copy_colour_registers_direct
description: Copies four groups of words into the Amiga custom chip colour registers starting at the first colour register.

name: copy_block_back_by_flag
description: When a flag word is set, copies a short block of longwords out of a buffer into the destination, choosing the buffer by the flag, then returns.

name: fade_nibble_palette_entries
description: Steps every 4-bit colour component of a block of palette bytes one unit toward zero, the high components only on odd entries, repeating while any component changed.

name: repeat_pair_while_count
description: Calls one routine, then repeatedly calls two routines until a counter reaches zero.

name: call_then_repeat_pair
description: Optionally calls one routine, then repeatedly calls two routines until a counter reaches zero.

name: load_view_after_two_calls
description: Calls two routines, then switches the displayed view through the graphics library's load-view call.

name: load_view_after_call
description: Calls one routine, then switches the displayed view through the graphics library's load-view call.

name: step_palette_toward_target
description: Moves each 4-bit colour component of one palette block one step toward the matching component of a target block, for each entry in a loop.

name: branch_clear_state_word
description: Calls two routines, then either calls a third routine when a flag is nonzero or clears a game-state word.

name: fade_palette_from_source
description: Copies eight words of colour data from a source pointer into a work area, then processes each entry by separating its 4-bit colour components and reducing or raising each one.

name: blend_rgb4_colour_value
description: Splits two 12-bit colour values into their 4-bit components, scales one set by a fraction out of fifteen, blends it with the other, and recombines the result into a new colour value.

name: clear_rectangle_across_planes
description: Clears a rectangle of bitplane words across all four planes, with the size and position taken from four game-state coordinate values and a row stride.

name: blit_bitmap_via_library
description: Calls the graphics library's bit-block copy through the library base and returns.

name: blit_bitmap_via_library
description: Calls the graphics library's bit-block copy through the library base and returns.

name: blit_bitmap_via_library
description: Calls the graphics library's bit-block copy through the library base and returns.

name: blit_bitmap_via_library
description: Calls the graphics library's bit-block copy through the library base and returns.

name: advance_scroll_offset_wrap
description: Advances a wrapping offset stored in a global word by three on each call, resetting it when it passes its limit, and calls a bitmap copy when the offset is not at its starting value.

name: copy_rect_row_offsets
description: Computes source and destination offsets for a rectangular copy from coordinate differences and a row table, then copies the rows in a loop.

name: blit_if_below_limit
description: Calls the graphics library's bit-block copy only when a value is below a fixed limit.

name: blit_if_positive
description: Calls the graphics library's bit-block copy only when a value is greater than zero.

name: clip_rectangle_to_window
description: Clips a rectangle's horizontal and vertical extents against limits held in game state, adjusting its source and destination values to match before drawing it.

name: blit_twice_after_setup
description: Calls one routine to obtain a value, then makes two graphics library bit-block copies, the first using that value.

name: blit_twice_after_setup
description: Calls one routine to obtain a value, then makes two graphics library bit-block copies, the first using that value.

name: read_byte_via_dos
description: Calls the DOS library's read routine through the library base and returns the single byte it stores into a game-state location.

name: silence_audio_channel_state
description: Calls four routines, zeroes four audio-channel state words, then runs a short busy wait.

name: forward_single_routine_call
description: Calls a single routine and returns, with no other work.

name: start_audio_channel_playback
description: Starts playback on one audio channel: sets the channel's bit in the DMA control and interrupt enable registers, waits for the vertical blank, and writes the sample address and length to that channel's hardware registers.

name: load_audio_channel_registers
description: When the enable word is clear, writes a sample address, length and period into one audio channel's hardware registers and records the channel's state in game state.

name: update_audio_channels_by_mask
description: Updates the audio channels selected by bits of a mask: for each selected channel it calls routines with a volume value, then stores a new length value in game state.

name: busy_wait_countdown
description: Counts a 16-bit counter down from a fixed start value to zero, acting as a pure busy-wait delay.

name: select_lowest_channel_bit
description: Stores a channel mask byte, finds the position of its lowest set bit, and uses that position to look up a value stored with a count and a step in game state.

name: update_audio_channel_periods
description: Computes a new audio period from a stored product and writes it to each selected channel's period register, with a mode state that starts or ends a tone sweep.

name: compute_dma_channel_mask
description: Computes a single bit mask for one DMA channel from its index and stores it in a game-state word.

name: reset_playback_state_words
description: Calls four routines, then zeroes a group of game-state words and sets a flag word to one.

name: read_command_letter_after_spaces
description: Reads characters until one is not a space; if that character is the letter g it sets a flag and reads until a nonzero character arrives, then sets a result word to minus one.

name: wait_for_nonzero_char_input
description: Sets a flag, reads characters until a nonzero one arrives, clears the flag, and sets a result word to minus one.

name: advance_sequence_step
description: Advances a step counter and reads the next entry of a sequence table; a zero entry runs bookkeeping and loads a value from a table, while other steps call update routines for the active channels.

name: clear_playback_flag_and_return
description: Sets a flag word to zero and returns.

name: scan_event_table_for_entry
description: Loops over a table of event entries up to a fixed count, storing the address of the selected entry into a slot in the structure, then clears a few state words before returning.

name: set_flag_from_call_result
description: Calls a routine and stores one or minus one in a game-state word depending on whether its result is zero.

name: store_table_pointer_from_index
description: Calls a routine to obtain an index and stores the address of the matching table entry, relative to the current structure, in a pointer slot.

name: store_table_word_from_index
description: Calls a routine to obtain an index and copies the matching word from a game-state table into a game-state word.

name: store_second_table_pointer
description: Calls a routine to obtain an index and stores the address of the matching table entry, relative to the current structure, in a second pointer slot.

name: call_two_routines_return_pair
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns the pair of result registers unchanged.

name: restart_audio_channel_playback
description: If the channel is already active, waits through a fixed delay loop, then marks the channel as restarting and writes the sample address and length to its hardware registers.

name: copy_sixteen_longwords_then_call
description: When an output pointer is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset in the structure into it, then calls a routine through a pointer register.

name: run_endcli_entry_point
description: Program entry for the command-line helper: calls a startup routine, walks a linked list of entries to find the largest value in a field, and prepares a buffer from that value.

name: copy_sixteen_longwords_then_call
description: When an output pointer is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset in the structure into it, then calls a routine through a pointer register.

name: start_workbench_loader_entry
description: Starts the Workbench loader: opens the DOS library by name, finds the current task, allocates memory, opens the NIL device, waits for and reads messages, and raises an alert on failure.

name: restore_task_window_pointer
description: Finds the current task, swaps the saved pointer in its structure for the value passed in, runs a cleanup call when one entry is set, and returns the passed value.

name: start_workbench_tool_process
description: Opens the icon and intuition libraries, checks command-line switches such as the debug option, looks up the Workbench task's resident tag and starts the tool, reporting an error if it cannot be started.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte, returning minus one when the first is smaller, one when the first is larger, and zero when they are equal.

name: build_resident_node_list
description: Allocates eight-byte nodes in a loop, stores a lookup result in each node's second field, links the nodes into a list, and returns the first node; it stops early when an allocation or lookup fails.

name: append_version_padding
description: Checks a version character in a name buffer, and when it is a two, copies a fixed five-byte padding sequence into the buffer after the name.

name: write_dot_padding_field
description: Writes a dot followed by four spaces into a name buffer at a fixed offset.

name: compare_prefix_with_global
description: Compares a global text string with a buffer character by character, returning when the global string ends or the characters differ.

name: stub_return_only
description: Empty routine that only returns and performs no work.

name: forward_pair_with_stack_slot
description: Calls a routine with its two parameters and a pointer to a stack slot, then returns.

name: format_message_to_buffer
description: Formats a message with the exec library's raw formatter into a 140-byte stack buffer, measures its length by scanning for the terminator, then passes the result on to a routine.

name: run_port_handler_entry
description: Entry point of the Port-Handler program: a long routine that compares values against AmigaDOS hunk type codes while loading and relocating executable sections.

name: run_disk_validator_entry
description: Entry point of the Disk-Validator program: sets up table and bitmap words in its workspace and calls library routines in loops.

name: run_ram_handler_entry
description: Entry point of the Ram-Handler program: calls the exec library's memory-copy routine, then makes an indirect call through a table whose target could not be recovered.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The recovered code is only bad instruction data that stops decoding at once, so no behaviour can be read from it.

name: allocate_device_buffer_fields
description: When a second argument is nonzero, calls a library routine to release it; when the first argument is nonzero, calls a library routine to allocate and stores the result into several device fields, clearing them otherwise.

name: set_request_status_and_check
description: Stores a fixed status byte into the request and, when a flag test passes, calls a handler taken from the device table.

name: set_interrupt_control_bits
description: Writes an interrupt control word to a hardware register, calls a routine, then writes a second control word with an extra bit set.

name: unlink_request_from_queue
description: Clears a flag byte in the request and, when the request is in state two, removes it from its queue and clears the device's busy bit if it was the active request.

name: clear_active_or_unlink_request
description: If the request is the active one, clears the busy bit and resets the active pointer; otherwise, if the request is marked queued, unlinks it from its list and decrements the queue count.

name: unlink_and_mark_request_done
description: If the request is marked queued, unlinks it from its list, decrements the queue count, and sets and then clears status bits in the request.

name: finish_active_request
description: When the request is the active one, handles one request type by writing a control value and calling a library routine, then clears the active pointer and a busy bit.

name: unlink_queued_request_with_call
description: If the request is queued, unlinks it from its list, updates the queue count and status bits, then calls a library routine.

name: queue_request_or_mark_pending
description: If a request field is nonzero, sets a pending bit and returns zero; otherwise calls two device routines and returns a result.

name: call_serial_library_vectors_sequence
description: Calls several exec library vectors through the device base in turn, reads a word from the unit structure and passes it to a further library call before returning.

name: mark_request_queued_or_busy
description: When a request has a nonzero length, clears its state bit if the unit is busy or an earlier request is pending, sets its queued bit, and makes a library call to link it.

name: find_matching_serial_request
description: Walks a linked list of requests, testing each one's fields against the device state, and returns the first matching request or nothing when the count is exhausted.

name: move_data_between_request_buffers
description: Loops while a byte count is nonzero, comparing buffer positions and flags, and moves data between the device buffer and request buffers through helper routines until nothing remains.

name: store_byte_to_serial_buffer
description: Stores the byte from the register into the buffer pointer taken from the device, then checks a flag and calls one or two routines depending on it.

name: set_request_status_nine
description: Calls a routine to obtain a value, then sets the request's status byte to nine on one branch; the rest of the routine is not recovered.

name: clear_status_bit_and_write
description: Clears one bit of a status value selected by a device field, then writes the result byte to the buffer pointer in a loop, calling a library routine as each byte is written.

name: stub_return_only
description: Empty routine that only returns and performs no work.

name: clear_device_flag_bit_four
description: Clears one bit in a device flag byte and, depending on its previous value, updates a second status byte and calls routines.

name: clear_flag_and_set_status
description: Clears the top bit of a device flag byte, and when that bit was previously clear sets the request status byte to twelve before calling a routine.

name: set_status_twelve_or_six
description: Sets the request status byte to twelve, or to six when a flag bit is set, then calls a routine.

name: handle_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Reads the serial data register, acknowledges the receive interrupt request, and passes the received byte to helper routines.

name: update_serial_interrupt_enable
description: When a byte matches the device's expected value and a flag bit is set, clears that bit and writes a control word with the enable bit set to the interrupt enable register; otherwise it takes the other branch.

name: dispatch_serial_status_bits
description: Calls routines to read a status value, then chooses a branch from bits of that value; the decompilation of the rest is incomplete.

name: append_byte_to_serial_buffer
description: When bit eight of the value is clear, stores the byte into the buffer if space remains, advancing the buffer pointer and count, and calls a routine when the buffer reaches its limit.

name: start_serial_transfer_if_needed
description: Checks a value's bit eight, and when it is clear sets the device's transfer-active flag, records the buffer start if it is unset, and continues to a shared routine.

name: set_transfer_active_and_call
description: Sets the device's transfer-active flag, records the buffer start if it is unset, then calls a library routine through the device base.

name: append_register_byte_to_buffer
description: Appends a byte from the register to the buffer if space remains, advancing the buffer pointer and count, and calls a routine when the buffer reaches its limit.

name: record_buffer_start_and_call
description: Records the buffer start in the device if it is unset, calls a routine, then calls a library routine through the device base.

name: update_serial_control_lines
description: Copies a control value into a device field, clears a status bit, updates the control bit of the CIA port register to drive the serial control lines, then calls a routine.
